0DC2.name: Reserve item (item box)
desc: The power-up stored in Mario's item box for the current player: the reserve item that drops when Select is pressed
or Mario is hit. Copied to and from each player's own slot ($0DBC,X) when the overworld is entered or left.
Written when a power-up is collected with the box empty, cleared on file select and the Bowser scene; read by the status bar and the item drop.
Values: 0 = empty; otherwise the power-up number stored by the collect routine (item box contents).

0DC7.name: Overworld walk target position
0DC7.kind: word table, indexed by axis (X = 0: X, X = 2: Y)
desc: Where the player's overworld sprite is walking to. When a path step starts, the current map position
([$1F17,X] for X, [$1F19] for Y) plus the step offset is stored here. OW process 4 compares it with
the current position to find the remaining distance on each axis.

0DCF.name: Overworld walk speed per axis
0DCF.kind: word table, indexed by axis (X = 0: X, X = 2: Y)
desc: Signed speed at which the player's overworld sprite moves along the X axis (X = 0) and Y axis (X = 2) during
OW process 4 (walking along the path). Written each frame from the distance left, then added to the position.
Also matches labels CODE_0DCF.. in bank $0D (guide line objects), which are code, not RAM.

0DD3.name: Overworld walking direction
desc: Direction the player is currently walking on the overworld map. Set when a walk starts from a level tile and
read while following the path to pick the movement offsets.
Values: 0 = up; 2 = down; 4 = left; 6 = right.

0DD5.name: Level exit type / overworld event
desc: How the last level was left, so the overworld knows which path to unlock and where to walk. Set by the level
(goal, Select exit, death) and cleared when a level starts or the overworld finishes handling it.
Read by the overworld state routines to decide on auto-walk or events; the event routine also stores event values such as $E0 here.
Values: 0 = none; 1 = normal exit; 2 = secret exit; $80 = left the level with no exit event (death).

0DD6.name: Current player position slot (player * 4)
desc: Index of the current player's entries in the overworld position tables ($1F17, $1F19 etc.): 0 for Mario, 4 for Luigi.
Used as X or Y in most overworld code; divide by 4 for the player index. Set when a player is selected.

0DD8.name: Overworld input/transition flag
desc: Overworld flag: while non-zero the overworld input check is skipped (game mode 0E) and path walking
treats the state as pending. Cleared by the hardcoded path routine; incremented by the level name builder
(probably counts player switches). Exact purpose is not clear from the code.

0DDA.name: Music state
desc: Mirror of the level music in effect. Game mode 11 stores the intro music number here ($13 for the intro level);
bit 7 is set by power-up and tape events and cleared by the Mario draw routine (restore level music).
Set to $FF by Kill Mario, goal tape and some collision code so the level music reloads afterwards.
Values: 0 = no music request pending; $FF = force the level music to restart; bit 7 = music state flag.

0DDE.name: Current overworld sprite slot
desc: Slot number of the overworld sprite being processed. Stored by the process-all-sprites loop and reloaded by each
sprite routine as X. On the erase file menu (game mode 09) it is reused as a bit mask of files marked for erasing.
Values: 0 = no file marked (erase menu).

0DDF.name: Overworld sprite draw list / OAM offset
desc: Dual use. Indexed by X it is the sprite-slot list sorted by Y position (positions 1-4 of the 5 entry list that
starts at $0DE0), used to draw overworld sprites back to front. Read unindexed ($0DDF) it is the next free dynamic OAM offset;
reset to $30 at the start of each frame and advanced by the sprite tile drawing.

0DE0.name: Overworld sprite sort order
desc: List of overworld sprite slots 0-4 (the foreground sprites), initialised to 0,1,2,3,4 and bubble-sorted each frame by
Y position ($0E45,$0E75) so they are processed in depth order. Shares storage with the $0DDF list (offset by one).

0DE5.name: Overworld sprite type
0DE5.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Type of each of the 16 overworld sprites; 0 = slot free. It selects the routine from the OW sprite pointer table.
Written when a sprite is created and cleared when it goes off screen, which frees the slot.
Values: 0 = unused (free slot); 1-10 = index into the overworld sprite pointer table (e.g. 5 = cloud, 6 = walks in on tiles $49-$4B).

0DE8.name: Overworld sprite type, slot 3
desc: This is slot 3 of the overworld sprite type table at $0DE5, written when overworld sprites are initialised.
Also matches labels CODE_0DE8.. in bank $0D (tileset object handlers), which are code, not RAM.

0DF5.name: Overworld sprite state / direction
0DF5.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: General per-slot byte of the overworld sprites; meaning depends on the sprite type. Examples: active flag and
properties ($12 plus a random X flip, sprites 3-5); state 2 (sprite 6, walk-in); animation phase wrapped at 12
(sprites 7-8); X-axis direction index (sprites 9-10); random threshold index (sprite 1). Cleared at overworld setup.

0E05.name: Overworld sprite counter / Y direction
0E05.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Per-slot byte: bit 0 is the direction bit flipped by the hovering creature (sprite 1), an animation counter for
sprite 6 (incremented each frame), and the Y-axis direction index for the drifting sprites 9-10.

0E15.name: Overworld sprite animation counter
0E15.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Animation counter incremented by the drifting sprites (9-10) and read by the hovering creature; cleared when a sprite
arrives at its home position.

0E25.name: Overworld sprite timer
0E25.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Per-slot countdown. The process-all-sprites loop decrements it each frame while non-zero (for slots below $0D).
Meaning varies: splash timer set to $0F by sprites 3-5, wait timer for sprite 6, phase counter for sprites 9-10.

0E35.name: Overworld sprite X position, low
0E35.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Low byte of the sprite's X position on the overworld map ([$0E65,X] is the high byte). Set at spawn from per-type
data tables and used by the draw/move helpers.

0E45.name: Overworld sprite Y position, low
0E45.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Low byte of the sprite's Y position ([$0E75,X] is the high byte). Read as a 16-bit value with $0E75 to sort the
sprites by depth; sprite 2 copies Mario's Y into it.

0E55.name: Overworld sprite height (Z)
0E55.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Height of the sprite above the ground, used by the draw helper to offset the sprite's Y. Cloud sprites set it from a table at spawn.

0E65.name: Overworld sprite X position, high
0E65.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: High byte of the sprite's X position ([$0E35,X] is the low byte).

0E75.name: Overworld sprite Y position, high
0E75.kind: byte table, one per overworld sprite slot
desc: High byte of the sprite's Y position ([$0E45,X] is the low byte). Sprite 2 sets it to Mario's Y high byte.

0E95.name: Overworld sprite X speed
0E95.kind: byte table (signed), one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Signed X speed in 1/16 pixel per frame. Sprite 2 accelerates toward Mario and clamps to +/-$10; sprite 6 uses
$F0 (walks left), sprites 3-5 use 2 (drift right).

0EA5.name: Overworld sprite Y speed
0EA5.kind: byte table (signed), one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Signed Y speed in 1/16 pixel per frame. Set to $FF by sprites 3-5 (drifts up slowly), cleared to 0 by the helper when a sprite arrives.

0EB5.name: Overworld sprite Z speed
0EB5.kind: byte table (signed), one per overworld sprite slot
desc: Vertical (height) speed applied to $0E55. Set to $24 when launched upward (sprites 3-5), changed by +1 or -1 for the hovering creature, cleared on arrival.

0EF5.name: Overworld walking sprites spawned
desc: Which of the three sprite-6 walkers have already appeared. Level exit setup ORs in a bit from a table; sprite 6 reads it
so it only spawns when its bit is clear.
Bits: 7, 6 and 5 ($80, $40, $20): one per walker.

0EF7.name: Overworld sprite touching player
desc: Slot number of the overworld sprite the player is touching, or'd with $80 when sprite 6 marks a hit. Cleared to 0 each frame;
read by the level-exit and hardcoded-path code.
Values: 0 = nothing touching.

0F15.name: Status bar digit tiles
desc: Buffer of decimal digit tiles for the number being converted. The hex-to-decimal routines clear each digit and count up by
subtraction; the status bar update then replaces leading zeros with a blank tile ($FC).

0F1E.name: Status bar digit tiles (counters)
desc: Second digit-tile buffer for the status bar counters (such as bonus stars). The status bar update reads it, drops absent tens
digits and converts 8x8 digit tiles into 8x16 big digits.
